quotes.text: In Q3, we saw continued proof that institutions are building and expanding on USDC. Tereina is bringing USDC and EURC into the SAP ecosystem, Visa took stablecoin prefunding into commercial deployment, and Binance renewed and expanded our partnership.
quotes.by: Jeremy Allaire, Co-Founder, CEO, and Chairman at Circle

outlook: The deal is expected to close in 2027, pending regulatory approvals. ●​ Tazapay brings $25B+ in annualized payment volume, 60+ banking and fintech partners, and local payout rails covering 100+ markets.
